name: Vehicle
description:
Vehicle lets a token carry other tokens. Mark a boat, raft, wagon, flying carpet or mount as a vehicle, and every token aboard moves and turns with it, keeping its place on board.

HOW IT WORKS:
• When a vehicle is moved or rotated, its passengers are carried along. They swing around the vehicle's center when it turns, and can optionally turn to keep their facing relative to the vehicle.
• A token boards a vehicle when it is moved onto it (50% overlap by default, set per vehicle), and leaves when it is moved off. Moving a passenger never moves the vehicle.
• A vehicle does not pick up tokens it passes over. A horse ridden through a crowd leaves the crowd behind.
• When a token is made a vehicle, everything on it at that moment becomes a passenger. Set Passengers resets the list to whatever is on the vehicle now.
• Vehicles can carry other vehicles, such as a lifeboat on a ship. A token rides only the smallest vehicle it is on.
• Vehicles are kept behind other tokens, largest at the back, so passengers stay visible.
• Only tokens on the token layer are carried.

AREA:
Vehicle art often has empty space around the edges for shadows or grid fit. To mark where passengers actually stand, draw a rectangle over that part of the vehicle on the token layer, select the vehicle and the rectangle together, and click Set area. The rectangle is removed afterward. Show area draws a temporary yellow outline to check it. The area is kept as a percentage of the token, so it survives resizing, and it mirrors when the vehicle is flipped.

GETTING STARTED:
1. Install the script.
2. Select a token and type !vehicle in chat to open the menu.
3. Click Define. The token is now a vehicle, and anything on it is aboard.
4. Optionally set its area as described above.
5. Type !vehicle --list to see every vehicle on the page with its picture and settings, and change them from there. Click a vehicle's picture to pull everyone's view to it, or its name to pull only yours. Click N aboard to see and manage its passengers.
6. Click the ? button on any menu for help.

Vehicle settings and the passenger list are stored as a short tag in the token's tooltip, so a vehicle keeps them when the token is copied. Players will see the tag if that tooltip is shown to them.

OTHER SCRIPTS:
Moves made by TokenMod and ScriptCards are handled like moves by hand. Other scripts can call Vehicle.handleMove(token, prev) after moving a token.

LIMITS:
• Passengers move when the vehicle is dropped, not while it is being dragged.
• Resizing a vehicle does not move its passengers.
• Written for the current Roll20 tabletop (Jumpgate).
